messages:
eli_sales: quick thread for FinTrust POC 1 day trial ask: HSM-backed CMKs, attestation for security review, and a temporary peered tunnel. what do we need to promise for latency & escrow?
sam_ops: infra note: spinning a dedicated HSM + tunnel usually 2436h. add 48h if they want an offline import ceremony. need their whitelist + ephemeral certs.
tara_sec: we can provide attestation bundle (FIPS/CC + firmware manifest) and a brief KMS threat-model doc. also outline escrow choices: no-escrow, escrow-with-split-custody, or encrypted-backup-wrapped-by-customer. mark which require SOW.
eli_sales: can you bullet the escrow items with fees? FinTrust wants numbers to compare to competitors.
tara_sec: bullets: No-escrow = no fee, Redwood never holds KEK. Escrow-split (SOW) = $2k/mo (audit logs, dual approval, custodial ops). Customer-wrap-backup = $900/mo (storage + access controls). All subject to final legal terms.
sam_ops: latency: HSM wrap/unwrap adds ~3-9ms p99 locally; cross-region/tunnel adds RTT. factor that into SLAs.
ops-bot: attached: vendor-attest-2025.pdf (redacted). internal link: https://ok.redwood/sec/attestations/fintrust
eli_sales: can we offer a POC concession? recommend: 50% off first 2 weeks if they sign 12mo Dedicated within 30 days. tara, any legal flags?
tara_sec: concession ok but call out: any escrow/unwrapping requires co-signed SOW and auditable logs. include language about rotation policies (we support scheduled rotations within business hours or customer-controlled keys).
eli_sales: great. i'll draft email with attestation link, escrow bullets + fees, sanitized tunnel snippet, and concession. sam, paste a minimal sanitized snippet for the tunnel checklist.
sam_ops: snippet (sanitized):
```
# customer: create VPC endpoint and allow outbound to redwood HSM
resource "aws_vpc_endpoint" "rw_hsm" { vpc_id = "vpc-REDACTED" }
# firewall: allow tcp/443 to hsm.tunnel.redwood
# ephemeral client certs rotate every 12h by default
```
eli_sales: perfect. blockers: they must provide egress IP and sign AUP for red-team scans. aiming to start tunnel Mon. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
